chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: All of these reports indicate that it is appropriate for him to wash her from over the clothes. As for the woman, then what is preferable likewise is that she wash the man from over the clothes. And that which indicates this is...

key_terms.الثِّيَابِ: the clothes, meaning washing from over the garments
key_terms.الْأَخْبَارُ: the reports or hadiths being cited as evidence
key_terms.الْأَوْلَى: what is preferable or more appropriate
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman, here referring to the wife
key_terms.يُغَسِّلَهَا: he washes her, referring to ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: Is it preferable for a husband or wife to wash their deceased spouse from over the clothes?
ai.summary: This passage presents a legal conclusion that, when a spouse performs the ritual washing of the deceased spouse, it is preferable that the washing be done over the clothes. It reflects a fiqh discussion on the permissibility and preferred manner of spousal ghusl of the deceased.
